title: 第20章 陨落的天才
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
“你是不是很好奇，为什么我会知道？”似乎是看出陆沉眼中的疑惑，魅姬笑着开口。

    “还请小嫂嫂解答！”

    “其实一开始嘛，我对这些东西是不感兴趣，不过后来这事儿在你们正道联盟闹大了，搞的人众皆知，我就不得不调查了。”

    “没想到，我只是小小的一调查，就查出来你这么个好弟弟！”

    “我的事……有多少人知道？”

    “嗯…其实知道的人也不多，也就我们魔门的核心清楚！但毕竟我这人嘴不严，万一哪天跟姐妹们喝多了……”

    “你！！！！”陆沉急了。

    “别急呀。”魅姬收起手指，笑眯眯地看着他。

    “我又没说要告诉别人。只是……陆沉弟弟，你说，你要怎么收买我呢？”

    陆沉一愣。

    收买？他能给什么？灵石？人家魔门核心弟子不缺这个。

    法宝？他一个筑基修士能有什么好东西？

    他张了张嘴，一时竟想不出自己能给什么。

    “我……”

    魅姬看着他这副呆样，嘴角弯了弯。桌下，一只小脚从绣鞋里褪出来，悄悄伸了过去。

    陆沉正绞尽脑汁想着自己有什么拿得出手的东西，忽然感觉小腿被什么东西碰了一下。

    他低头一看。

    一只小玉正踩在他小腿上。

    他抬头，对上魅姬似笑非笑的眼睛。

    “关于庄静白的消息，我还是很上心的。”

    她的声音轻飘飘的，像是从很远的地方飘过来，脚趾顺着他的小腿慢慢往上蹭。

    “陆沉弟弟，你也不想……”

    “我同意！”

    陆沉几乎是喊出来的。

    他只用零秒就做出了选择。

    甚至比零秒还快。

    魅姬的停住了。她愣愣地看着陆沉，眨了眨眼，又眨了眨眼。

    然后她笑了。

    “哈哈哈……陆沉弟弟，你可真是个妙人……”

    “我还以为要费一番口舌呢，你倒好……”

    魅姬有些意犹未尽。

    因为她觉得好有意思。

    陆沉这个人，其实这段日子在正魔两道掀起了不小的风浪。
content_en:
"Are you curious as to why I know this?" Mei Ji seemed to see the confusion in Lu Chen's eyes, and said with a smile.

"Sister-in-law, please give me some answers!"

"Actually, I wasn't interested in these things at first, but then this matter became a big deal in your Righteous Alliance and everyone knew about it, so I had to investigate."

"I didn't expect that after just a small investigation, I found out that you are such a good brother!"

"How many people know about me?"

"Well... actually not many people know, only the core of our Demon Sect knows it! But after all, I am not strict with my words. If one day I drink too much with my sisters..."

"You!!!" Lu Chen was anxious.

"Don't worry." Mei Ji put away her fingers and looked at him with a smile.

"I didn't say I wanted to tell others. It's just...Brother Lu Chen, tell me, how are you going to bribe me?"

Lu Chen was stunned.

buy?What can he give?Spiritual stone?The core disciples of the Demon Sect are not short of this.

magic weapon?What good things can he have as a foundation-building monk?

He opened his mouth, but for a moment he couldn't think of what he could give.

"I..."

Meiji looked at his dumb look and curled her mouth.Under the table, a little foot slipped out of the embroidered shoe and stretched out quietly.

Lu Chen was racking his brains to think of something he could use, when he suddenly felt something touch his calf.

He looked down.

A small jade was stepping on his calf.

He raised his head and met Mei Ji's smiling eyes.

"I am still very concerned about the news about Zhuang Jingbai."

Her voice was light and airy, as if floating from a far away place, and her toes slowly rubbed up his calf.

"Brother Lu Chen, you don't want to either..."

"I agree!"

Lu Chen almost shouted.

It took him zero seconds to make his choice.

Even faster than zero seconds.

Mei Ji stopped.She stared at Lu Chen blankly, blinked, and then blinked.

Then she smiled.

"Hahaha...Brother Lu Chen, you are such a wonderful person..."

"I thought it would take a lot of talking, but you'd better..."

Mei Ji still had some unfinished thoughts.

Because she found it so interesting.

Lu Chen has actually caused quite a stir in both good and evil circles these days.
